Metadata.title: Lango: government services in one place
Metadata.description: Describe what you need in your own words. Lango shows you the right government site, the documents to prepare and the steps to follow.

Hero.title: What do you need to do today?
Hero.subtitle: Type it in your own words. We'll point you to the right government site and walk you through the steps.

Search.label: Type the service you are looking for

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.lede: Lango is a guide. We don't complete your application; we show you the right way to do it.

steps.title: Say what you need
steps.body: In Swahili, English or a mix. You don't need to know which agency handles it.

steps.title: Prepare documents and follow the steps
steps.body: We show the documents to prepare and the steps in order, and your progress stays on your phone.

steps.title: Finish on the official site
steps.body: One button takes you straight to the agency's own website.

Trust.title: Your details stay with you
Trust.body: We never ask for your password, NIDA number or phone number. You sign in directly on the official government site.

SearchPage.title: Find a service
SearchPage.comingSoonBody: We're preparing a list of verified services. Please check back shortly.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The link may have changed or no longer exists.

Footer.disclaimer: Lango is an independent guide, not a government website. Check every step on the agency's own site before you pay or submit.
Footer.privacy: Your step progress is saved on your device only.
